apps.localizedDescription:
白 Shirox:

Your anime and manga library, entirely yours.

A free, source-available library manager for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Track what you watch and read, keep it in sync with AniList and MyAnimeList, and play it from the sources you connect.

What it is:

Shirox ships with no content of its own. It's a native SwiftUI shell around three things you bring: your tracker account (AniList or MyAnimeList), your sources (modules, a Jellyfin server, or files on your device), and your library. Everything else — progress, downloads, playback, reading — happens on your device.

Shirox does not host, provide or endorse any content.

Tracking:

• AniList and MyAnimeList side by side, with per-provider toggles for what gets written where.

• Continue Watching and Continue Reading pick up mid-episode and mid-chapter.

versions.localizedDescription:
Subtitles: every cue on screen is shown at once, so a long sign no longer hides the dialogue under it. Bottom Padding goes up to 400 pt, so subtitles can sit on the picture when you watch in portrait. The units on the Subtitles settings page are translated.

Simkl: episodes of a title opened from Simkl can be downloaded and have their progress reset from their menu, like AniList episodes.

Shirox speaks Thai, in Settings › General › Change Language. The Started On and Finished On labels read as dates in every language, and the already downloaded and already queued toasts are translated.

App icons: Manga, a new home screen icon in Settings › General › App Icon.

Also: the player's subtitle settings and episode pickers take your accent color, holding the tab bar opens its menu on every tab when the bar minimizes on scroll, and a few spots that could crash on bad input from a server now handle it.

Downloads: Shirox.ipa (iPhone, iPad), Shirox-macOS.dmg (Mac), Shirox-Catalyst.dmg (Mac, Catalyst build).

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Shirox uses the local network to discover and cast to Chromecast devices.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Shirox uses device motion to rotate the player between landscape sides.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Shirox saves video frames and manga pages to your Photos library when you ask it to.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Shirox finds or creates a Shirox album to organize saved video frames and manga pages in Photos.
